name: Venusaur
anchor: Venusaur, a massive squat quadrupedal amphibian-like creature about 2 m long and 100 kg
appearance: bumpy blue-green skin with darker patches
a huge fully open pink flower with white spots on its back, five broad petals
a thick brown palm-like trunk under the flower, large green leaves draping over the flanks
heavy wide-set legs, small red eyes

sexDifferences.note: Bulbapedia: Venusaur cái có nhụy (gynoecium) ở giữa hoa
female: a distinct seed-like pistil (gynoecium) standing in the center of the flower
male: the center of the flower is open and empty, no pistil

canon.fact: hoa nở khi hấp thụ năng lượng mặt trời; luôn di chuyển để tìm nắng
chuyển nắng thành năng lượng nên mạnh nhất vào mùa hè
sau ngày mưa hoa thơm hơn; mùi hương thu hút các Pokémon khác

states.female: female Venusaur, pistil clearly visible in the flower center
states.male: male Venusaur, flower center open with no pistil

invariants: huge open pink flower with white spots
thick brown trunk under the flower
forbidden: more than one flower on one body
